title.en: An Act Appropriating the Sum of Sixty thousand Pesos for Maintenance and for the Construction of that Part of the Naguilian-Baguio Road, Including Bridges and Culverts, Lying Within the Mountain Province.

text.en:
The sum of sixty thousand pesos, or so much Appropriation, thereof as may be necessary, is
hereby appropriated, out of any funds in the Insular Treasury not otherwise appropriated, to be expended
under the direction of the Secretary of Commerce and Police for the maintenance and additional construction
of that part of the Naguilian-Baguio Road, lying within the Mountain Province.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, September 16, 1914.
